description: Source code for X509_ATTRIBUTE handling in OpenSSL, including creation, setting, and retrieval of attribute objects and data.

methods.name: X509_ATTRIBUTE_create_by_NID
methods.description: Creates an X509_ATTRIBUTE object using a NID identifier, attribute type, and data.

methods.name: X509_ATTRIBUTE_create_by_OBJ
methods.description: Creates or modifies an X509_ATTRIBUTE object with a specified ASN1_OBJECT, attribute type, and data.

methods.name: X509_ATTRIBUTE_create_by_txt
methods.description: Creates an X509_ATTRIBUTE object from a textual attribute name.

methods.name: X509_ATTRIBUTE_set1_object
methods.description: Sets the ASN1_OBJECT of an X509_ATTRIBUTE.

methods.name: X509_ATTRIBUTE_set1_data
methods.description: Sets the data for an X509_ATTRIBUTE with specified type and data.

methods.name: X509_ATTRIBUTE_count
methods.description: Returns the number of values in the attribute.

methods.name: X509_ATTRIBUTE_get0_object
methods.description: Retrieves the ASN1_OBJECT associated with the attribute.

methods.name: X509_ATTRIBUTE_get0_data
methods.description: Retrieves data from the attribute at a specified index and type.

methods.name: X509_ATTRIBUTE_get0_type
methods.description: Retrieves the ASN1_TYPE at a specified index in the attribute.
